name: MailLaser Self-Hosted Email-to-Webhook
free_limit: Self-hosted MIT-licensed SMTP receiver converts incoming emails into JSON webhook POSTs; supports Docker or standalone binaries, attachment forwarding, optional SPF/DKIM/DMARC checks, retries and signed webhooks. No vendor-imposed subscription period or message quota documented for the software.
watch_out: You must provide your own server, DNS/MX records and webhook endpoint; infrastructure, S3-compatible attachment storage and downstream integrations may incur charges. Configure recipient restrictions, sender authentication and webhook signing before exposing SMTP publicly. Not a hosted email delivery allowance.
